nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 依事件時間、背景與目前關聯，在短文中維持清楚一致的時態。
nodes.form: choose tense from communicative timeline, not one keyword

naturalExamples.text: I was walking home when I found the key.
We have kept the key since that day.
The box was locked, so we asked a teacher for help.
Now we are studying the map inside it.

wrong.text: Yesterday we find a key and now we kept it.

better.text: Yesterday we found a key, and we have kept it since then.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 已結束事件用 found；從過去持續到現在用 have kept。

wrong.text: I was opening the box, and I saw an old map inside.

better.text: I opened the box and saw an old map inside.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 兩個依序完成的主要事件通常都用過去簡單式。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 我正在回家時開始下雨，所以我跑到商店。

wrong.text: I walked home when it was starting to rain, so I run to a store.

better.text: I was walking home when it started to rain, so I ran to a store.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 背景動作用過去進行，短事件與後續事件用過去簡單式。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 我們從星期一起就在做這份報告。

wrong.text: We worked on this report since Monday.

better.text: We have worked on this report since Monday.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: since Monday 連到現在時使用現在完成式。

nodes.titleEn: Passive Voice for Processes and Focus
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 在做事者未知、不重要或流程本身較重要時使用被動。

naturalExamples.text: The bottles are washed before they are reused.
The bridge was built in 1998.
The results are checked by two students.
This material can be recycled.

wrong.text: The bottles are wash before reuse.

better.text: The bottles are washed before reuse.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 被動使用 be + 過去分詞 washed。

wrong.text: The bridge was build in 1998.

better.text: The bridge was built in 1998.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: build 的過去分詞是不規則形式 built。

wrong.text: The paper is sort at the factory.

better.text: The paper is sorted at the factory.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: is 後接過去分詞 sorted。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 學生每天使用這台機器。

wrong.text: This machine is used by students every day.

better.text: Students use this machine every day.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 若做事者 students 是句子重點，主動句通常更直接自然。

notesZh: 被動不是較正式就一定較好；是否使用取決於資訊焦點。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 區分時刻表、已安排活動、意圖計畫與即時決定或預測。
nodes.form: present simple schedule; present continuous arrangement; going to plan/evidence; will decision/prediction

naturalExamples.text: The train leaves at six tomorrow.
I am meeting Ms. Lee after school.
We are going to build a model.
I think the plan will work.

wrong.text: I will meeting Ms. Lee tomorrow.

better.text: I am meeting Ms. Lee tomorrow.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 已安排的會面可用現在進行式；will 後也不能接 meeting。

wrong.text: Look at those clouds. It will rain.

better.text: Look at those clouds. It is going to rain.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 根據眼前跡象的預測，going to 通常較自然。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 公車明天早上七點出發。

wrong.text: The bus will leaves at seven tomorrow.

better.text: The bus leaves at seven tomorrow.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 固定時刻表可用現在簡單式；will 後也不能加 -s。

wrong.text: The phone is ringing. I am going to answer it.

better.text: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 說話當下的即時決定常使用 will。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用 according to、says that、explained that 等方式忠實標示資訊來源。
nodes.form: According to + noun, clause; source + says/explains that + clause

naturalExamples.text: According to the report, traffic has increased.
The article says that the river is cleaner now.
Ms. Chen explained that the test was safe.
Leo said, "We need more evidence."

wrong.text: According to the article says the park is safer.

better.text: According to the article, the park is safer.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: according to 已引入來源，後面不要再加 says 形成雙重結構。

wrong.text: Amy said me that the test was easy.

better.text: Amy told me that the test was easy.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: tell 可直接接受詞 me；say 通常不使用 said me。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 根據老師說，活動取消了。

wrong.text: According to the teacher said, the event was canceled.

better.text: According to the teacher, the event was canceled.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 避免 according to 與 said 疊在同一來源結構。

wrong.text: The article says the water quality improved already.

better.text: The article says that the water quality has improved.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 報告目前相關的改善結果時，has improved 較清楚自然。

forms: Amy said that the test was easy.
Amy told me that the test was easy.
acceptableVariants.noteZh: say 著重內容；tell 通常要指出接收資訊的人。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 使用時間順序、連接語、代名詞與關鍵詞重複建立清楚段落。
nodes.form: ordered connectors + clear reference + controlled repetition

naturalExamples.text: First, we measured the water. Then, we recorded the result.
The first plan is cheaper. However, the second plan is safer.
The team tested the bridge. This test revealed a weak point.
Solar panels cost more at first. Therefore, we compared long-term savings.

wrong.text: The first plan is cheaper. Therefore, the second plan is safer.

better.text: The first plan is cheaper. However, the second plan is safer.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 兩項優點形成對比，使用 however，不是結果 therefore。

wrong.text: We changed the route. This was better.

better.text: We changed the route. This change made the walk safer.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: this 單獨指涉可能含糊；補上名詞 change 更清楚。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 我們先訪問居民。最後，我們整理答案。

wrong.text: First, we interviewed residents. Finally, we organized their answers.

better.text: First, we interviewed residents. Next, we organized their answers.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 只有兩個緊接步驟時 next 比 finally 更符合流程；若確為最後一步才用 finally。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 方案很便宜，因此它不安全。

wrong.text: The plan is cheap. Therefore, it is unsafe.

better.text: The plan is cheap, but it may not be safe.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 便宜不必然導致不安全；應標示轉折或可能性。
